creative_direction: Show an original pair of folded over-ear headphones resting on a compact charging dock. The earcups are matte violet metal, the cushions charcoal fabric, and a small transparent cyan panel reveals a simple internal light channel. One narrow orange status light provides a warm accent without displaying any text or icon. Use a dark slate background and a low three-quarter camera angle that makes the folded shape compact. Render stitching, brushed metal edges, tiny fasteners, and soft wear on the cushions, avoiding a clutter of circuitry. Keep the dock plain and the product unbranded. Reflections should be controlled, with sharp colored edges and a calm grounded shadow.
